title: Suite-schema extension
description: What a workspace adds to the core suite schema, imported by a catalog under suiteSchema (DEC-S10). It can add fields to four places and definitions they refer to, and nothing else: it cannot remove, loosen or redefine a core field, so a suite valid against the core stays valid.

suite.description: Fields added to the top level of a suite, by name. A name the core already declares is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON Schema for one added field.

defaults.description: Fields added to the defaults block, by name. A name the core already declares is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON Schema for one added field.

case.description: Fields added to a case, by name. A name the core already declares is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON Schema for one added field.

step.description: Fields added to every step: each action's branch, the step envelope and a meta step use site, by name. A name the core already declares is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON Schema for one added field.

$defs.description: Definitions the added fields refer to as #/$defs/<name>. A name the core already defines is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON Schema for one added field.
